messages.content: Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. Copy the span of words that lies between (and including) index 5 and 15, the indices are word indices, split by whitespace!

message.content:
FADE IN:

EXT. LAKESHORE - DAWN

A lone FIGURE (40s, weathered hands, sun-bleached shirt) kneels at the edge of a still, mirror-like lake. The sky above is a bruised purple, the sun already half-swallowed by a crescent of darkness.

The Figure's hand plunges into the water. SPLASH. He grips something slick and silver.

He PULLS.

A FISH — a common bluegill, no bigger than a palm — thrashes in the air. Gills flaring. Scales catching the dimmed light like scattered coins.

The Figure holds the fish up. Forces its eye — one wide, black, unblinking orb — toward the sky.

The fish STARES.

Above: the sun, now 70% eclipsed. A ring of molten gold frames the black disc. The air hums with a frequency only the fish can hear.

The Figure whispers:

FIGURE
(softly)
"Look. Just look."

The fish's gills pump. In. Out. In. Out.

The eclipse completes. TOTALITY. The sky goes black. Stars bloom.

The fish stares into the void where the sun was.

Its eye reflects the corona — a halo of white fire in the darkness of its pupil.

A long beat.

The Figure releases the fish. It drops. SPLASH. The lake closes over it.

The Figure watches. Then stands. Walks away.

FADE OUT.

---

**Copied span (word indices 5–15, inclusive):**

- DAWN A lone FIGURE (40s, weathered hands, sun-bleached shirt) kneels
